page.layout: Blank outer side of a limp vellum binding, with no printed text. Two leather or vellum ties are visible, one at the upper left and one at the upper right edge.
page.notes: Blank vellum cover: no printed text, running head, page number, catchword or signature. Stains, discolouration and wrinkles in the vellum are visible but are not printed matter. Tie remnants at the left and right edges, and small metal or leather fastenings along the right edge, belong to the binding and are not text.
